# Jin AI

> Structured for AI. Simple for people.

Jin AI is a visual workspace for AI-generated work, with Markdown as the spine.
It makes file structure visible, editable and reversible for business users
while preserving the files and instruction formats their agents already use.

## Canonical resources

- Human-readable product page: https://jinai.md/human/
- Agent-optimized product reference: https://jinai.md/agent/
- Structured JSON: https://jinai.md/agent/content.json

## Core product model

- Problem: You lose the file twice — first the name, then the location.
- Solution: See the structure, fix it like normal files, and undo human or agent changes separately.
- Agent integration: Jin AI writes structural decisions into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md.
- File model: Markdown remains the spine; decks, documents, spreadsheets, PDFs and links sit alongside it.
- Business model: Free for individual local use; paid for collaboration, cloud storage and company deployment.

## Evidence constraints

- One founder's laptop produced 3,950 Markdown files in one week.
- 89% were not reopened within a week.
- 283 were named README.md.
- This is one machine only, not market-wide evidence. Jin AI has not surveyed anyone else yet.
- Bergman et al. (ACM TOIS, 2008) found people reached files by navigation 56–68% of the time and search 4–15%.
